text:
{"guide": "Voice guide for Imani Castellan

Written by the offline stand in (fixed rules over the measured numbers). It is not a language model. Edit it freely.

Sentences: plain and medium, about 11 words. The length varies a little.
Paragraphs: long blocks of four or more sentences.
Tone: casual and spoken. Uses contractions freely.
Talking to the reader: often says you and we. Speaks from personal experience with I.
Questions and energy: asks the reader questions often. Uses exclamation marks.
Detail: uses few numbers.
Sentences most often start with a plain subject.
Favourite words: week, minutes, little, love, imani, first, something, every, three, students, write, favourite.
Phrases that keep coming back: ten minutes; a little; thank you; this week.

Never invent facts, numbers or stories. If a line needs a real example, leave a bracket for the author."}
